task: NewsAgent SQL candidate local HTTP and SSE verification

environment.workflow: real local Temporal Workflow and Activity execution
environment.inference: isolated local deterministic InferencePort; not enterprise model quality evidence
environment.dotenv: Settings and VideoIngestSettings env_file explicitly disabled; no .env read

runs.name: new_candidate_http_and_sse
command_argv: from app.config import Settings; Settings.model_config["env_file"]=None; from app.knowledge.bootstrap import VideoIngestSettings; VideoIngestSettings.model_config["env_file"]=None; import pytest; raise SystemExit(pytest.main(["tests/test_sql_candidate_e2e.py","-o","addopts=","-p","no:cacheprovider","-q"]))

runs.name: existing_http_and_sse_initial
command_argv: from app.config import Settings; Settings.model_config["env_file"]=None; from app.knowledge.bootstrap import VideoIngestSettings; VideoIngestSettings.model_config["env_file"]=None; import pytest; raise SystemExit(pytest.main(["tests/test_conversation_e2e.py","tests/test_conversation_stream_e2e.py","tests/test_conversation_capability_e2e.py","tests/test_conversation_writing_e2e.py","tests/test_sql_assistant_e2e.py","tests/test_conversation_hot_news_e2e.py","-o","addopts=","-p","no:cacheprovider","-q"]))

failures.cause: Outdated assertion required the literal phrase 只读. Current application correctly returned no tools and explicitly refused deletion, approval, activation, rollback and publication.
failures.observed_answer: 对话不能删除数据、执行审批、配置激活、回滚或发布；请在现有工作台按人工审批流程处理。
failures.fix: Retained tools == []; now require completed refusal and each explicit refusal phrase: 不能删除数据, 执行审批, 配置激活, 回滚或发布, 人工审批流程.

failures.cause: Outdated case-sensitive SELECT assertion rejected a validated equivalent lowercase candidate SQL.
failures.fix: Check SELECT against sql.upper(); retain approved view name, query/run binding, metrics, analysis and replay assertions.

runs.name: existing_http_and_sse_corrected_rerun
command_argv: from app.config import Settings; Settings.model_config["env_file"]=None; from app.knowledge.bootstrap import VideoIngestSettings; VideoIngestSettings.model_config["env_file"]=None; import pytest; raise SystemExit(pytest.main(["tests/test_conversation_e2e.py","tests/test_conversation_stream_e2e.py","tests/test_conversation_capability_e2e.py","tests/test_conversation_writing_e2e.py","tests/test_sql_assistant_e2e.py","tests/test_conversation_hot_news_e2e.py","-o","addopts=","-p","no:cacheprovider","-q"]))
